messages:
deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK FAILED — env-parity-check failed for service=embedder. Missing secret key in prod: EMBED_KEY_ALIAS. Release paused.
ashwin: assigning to me, looking now. @maria fyi.
maria: thanks. we rotated embed keys last night for staging but never pushed the prod alias. release notes referenced v2 alias. checking KMS.
lina: ouch. how did this get past staging smoke earlier?
ashwin: deploybot only checks secret existence today; our overlay defaults differ (`.Values.secrets.embed.path`). staging overlay set to `embed/key/v2`, prod still "embed/key/v1".
maria: quick repro: `kubectl -n inference get secret embed-keys -o yaml` -> prod: alias: "embed/key/v1", staging: "embed/key/v2". runbook suggests backfill with v2 alias if safe.
ashwin: options: 1) backfill prod secret with v2 alias (hotpatch), 2) rollback release to previous image not requiring v2, 3) make runtime accept both aliases via small shim.
lina: change window is tight — rollback impacts new batching improvements in canary. what's the risk/benefit? :thinking_face: 
release-eng: ops preference is rollback unless hotpatch is trivial. hotpatch during a change window is risky. propose pin image -> rollback, hold until morning.
maria: i can prepare rollback PR + changelog entry (pin model-variant and image). ETA ~20m.
ashwin: i can try a hotpatch script, quick command: `kubectl -n inference patch secret embed-keys --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/alias","value":"YmJlZC9rZXkvdjI="}]'`  # base64 for 'embed/key/v2'
lina: also filing a follow-up to tighten deploybot preflight: compare secret data content, not just presence.
deploybot: deploy paused. react with :white_check_mark: when ready to proceed.
maria: prepping rollback now.
release-eng: decision: rollback to image tag `registry/redwood/embedder:20260319` and hold promotion until 10:00UTC tomorrow. if hotpatch proves safe in <15m and ops signs off, we can re-promote.
maria: rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/embedder embedder=registry/redwood/embedder:20260319 -n inference` — applying.
deploybot: detected image change, running post-deploy checks.
lina: monitoring logs + traces.
ashwin: ran hotpatch test in staging, but prod KMS permissions block the script — need an admin grant, not safe for immediate hotpatch.
maria: rollback completed. health checks green, traffic stable. updating release notes: "rollback: embedder image pinned due to secret alias rotation; follow-up to reconcile secret aliases across environments."
release-eng: adding ticket to backlog: deploybot preflight rule to compare secret alias/base64 value + a daily canary secret-sync job. assigning to ops.
lina: thanks all. :thumbsup: 
deploybot: thread closed by deploybot after rollback success check.
